facts.fact: The government launched Konkoe (SIGPEM) on 26 October 2026, a digital one-stop platform where artisanal and industrial fishers apply for licences and track files from phone or computer, per the fisheries minister.

systems.owner: Ministry of Fisheries and Maritime Economy
systems.tiers: three rollout lots; lot 1 covers shipowners, vessel registry, licences and EEZ access
